The '''2026–27 Tahiti Ligue 1''' was the 80th season of [[Tahiti Ligue 1]], the top-league in [[Tahitian Football Federation]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Saltori |first=Rafael |date=2026-09-07 |title=Tahiti reshapes domestic football as new Super Ligue opens path to OFC Champions League |url=https://oceaniafootballcenter.org/2026/09/06/tahiti-reshapes-domestic-football-as-new-super-ligue-opens-path-to-ofc-champions-league/ |access-date=2026-09-17 |website=Oceania Football Center |language=en}}</ref>

There will be 16 teams that will play 15 (1 against each other) games each.
